page: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled at clock speeds up to 4.2 GHz. Cache resources are substantial, consisting of 48 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and a large 480 MB shared L3 cache. Memory capacity sits at 384 GB of RAM, sustaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The CPU incorporates modern vector and matrix extensions, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX instructions.

Integrated hardware includes 2835 GB of local NVMe solid-state storage alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not include a discrete GPU accelerator. In benchmark tests, the CPU demonstrated strong performance in PassMark compute metrics, cryptographic tests utilizing hardware AES acceleration, and multithreaded bzip3 decompression. Key-value operations showed high throughput, reaching 76.28 million Redis SET operations per second, complemented by 61.11 GB/sec of static web serving bandwidth.

Small and medium language model prompt evaluation shows strong performance due to AMX and AVX-512 instruction support, though generation throughput scales down substantially on large 70-billion parameter models due to lack of dedicated GPU hardware. Memory bandwidth metrics, stress-ng multi-core testing, and database operational benchmarks place the server in the middle performance quartile across cloud hardware tiers.

The combination of 384 GB of system memory, fast local NVMe capacity, and dedicated compute density yields favorable cost efficiency for architectures needing high in-memory capacity paired with fast local scratch space. Microsoft Azure E48ds_v7 is aligned with workloads such as large in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, high-volume transactional web backends, and intensive data processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs and 24 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. Supported by a 480 MB L3 cache, the system supplies 384 GB of memory at an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, coupled with 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The processor incorporates AVX-512 and Intel AMX acceleration. Synthetic testing highlights strong multi-threaded decompression, hardware encryption, and high-throughput key-value handling, registering over 76 million Redis SET operations per second. While small and medium LLM prompt processing performs well via matrix extensions, memory bandwidth metrics and large-model inference remain moderate without dedicated GPU acceleration. This profile offers efficient density for memory-bound applications, large transactional databases, enterprise caching layers, and high-throughput ETL data pipelines.
